articles.headline: What’s not to like? Billionaire Dan Gilbert's rare family story
articles.summary: Dan Gilbert wears many hats: NBA owner, entrepreneur, Detroit booster and Dad. While building Rocket Companies and investing billions in the Motor City’s development, he was a rare disease parent. Gilbert’s oldest child, Nick, died in 2023 following a lifelong battle with neurofibromatosis, a genetic disease. Famously, Nick was a good luck charm for the Cleveland Cavaliers. Since his death, the Gilbert family have pledged millions to fund research in the hopes of finding a cure for NF.
